features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via ImportPanel with file picker
features.evidence: Manual GUI verification on 2026-10-19: imported a .txt file and confirmed it appeared in the document list. The preload failure (`module not found: ../shared/types`) was fixed by using a local IPC_CHANNELS const enum; the rebuilt preload has no shared/types runtime dependency. The .md path, file-picker cancellation, unsupported extensions, and the 10 MB size limit/boundary have not been manually verified.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: Manual GUI verification on 2026-10-19: selecting an imported .txt document displayed its metadata and full text. The delete action has not been manually verified.

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage
features.evidence: Manual GUI restart test on 2026-10-19: imported test-document.txt, fully closed Electron, relaunched without re-importing, and verified restored metadata and full content.
